title: Kick Top 100 Streamers + KICK Circles Walkable World Explorer
description: Source-backed top-100 Kick streamer metrics enriched with a multi-axis, physically traversable world taxonomy for game, vibe, activity, reacts/troll, language, intensity, Circle identity and rooms.

important_interpretation.hours_watched: Viewer-hours accumulated during the rolling window; combines audience size and viewing duration.
important_interpretation.average_concurrent_viewers: Time-weighted average concurrent viewers over the rolling window.
important_interpretation.platform_category_note: The platform category table is aggregate category performance. It does not force each streamer into one genre, because Kick channels commonly switch categories.
important_interpretation.magnitude_note: Magnitude thresholds are transparent editorial bands created for this dataset, not official Kick labels.

data_quality.primary_provider: Kick Info (unofficial independent analytics; data computed from public Kick endpoints)
data_quality.metric_precision: Numeric values reproduce the rounded public leaderboard display. Numeric fields are approximate to the displayed k/M precision; *_display fields preserve the published representation.
data_quality.rank_coverage: Ranks 1-32 and 65-100 were read directly from global pagination. Ranks 33-64 were reconstructed by merging language leaderboards and sorting on the same 30-day hours-watched metric; displayed-value ties use estimated viewer-hours (average viewers × streamed hours) as a tie-break.
data_quality.rolling_window_warning: The leaderboard changes continuously. Small rank movements are expected after the as-of date.
known_source_limitations: Short discovery delays for new channels
A source-side bot filter excludes channels whose live viewers exceed followers
data_quality.world_taxonomy_note: World/vibe/social classifications are editorial product metadata. Confidence and evidence status are explicit per streamer; low-confidence placements require recent-VOD review.

kick_circles_world.name: KICK Circles — Walkable Discovery World
kick_circles_world.governing_idea: Most recommendation algorithms serve individuals. KICK Circles uses the same signals to build communities users can see and walk through.
kick_circles_world.core_design_law: Nothing is a menu that could be a place. Every discovery feature must exist as geography, weather, an inhabitant, an object, a path, a room, or a walk-up landmark. Panels may appear only after embodied interaction; the world remains the navigation.
kick_circles_world.primary_product_outcome: Turn broad streamer discovery into a physically traversable belonging funnel: spectacle -> taste -> recurring Circle -> intimate room -> visible role and contribution.

classification_status.platform_categories: Mixture of observed recent Kick categories and curated category history.
classification_status.vibe_activity_social_labels: Editorial product taxonomy inferred from public creator identity and content patterns; not creator self-identification.
classification_status.review_rule: Low-confidence classifications should be refreshed from recent VOD/category history before production ranking or moderation decisions.

design_laws: The world is the funnel: walking and zooming deeper always increases specificity and social intimacy.
Every creator may belong to many nodes; one primary home prevents disorientation while portals preserve multidimensional discovery.
Observed facts and inferred taste labels are stored separately.
Community identity is always legible through game/topic, style/vibe and lifespan.
Intensity is terrain, community health is vegetation, Pulse is weather, and progression is a walkable seasonal path.
Safety and maturity boundaries are visible geography, not hidden settings.
Language harbours preserve local culture and provide bridges rather than flattening everyone into one global feed.

matching_and_traversal_rules.home_selection: Choose the strongest stable identity as primary home; rank/magnitude changes architecture scale, not thematic identity.
matching_and_traversal_rules.secondary_membership: Every additional node becomes a visible portal, bridge, ferry route, cave exit or NPC-guided shortcut.
matching_and_traversal_rules.new_user_route: Start at Top Streamers Region, offer three embodied exits after 30–90 seconds: game realm, vibe archipelago and language harbour.
matching_and_traversal_rules.returning_user_route: Spawn at home camp; Pulse weather and Great Tree state show what changed without a feed.
matching_and_traversal_rules.deepening_route: Region -> district -> named Circle island -> room -> personal plot/role.
matching_and_traversal_rules.diversity_rule: At any junction, at least one route must lead outside the user’s dominant language, magnitude or content mode while preserving one shared taste axis.
matching_and_traversal_rules.small_creator_rule: SMALL/NICHE creators receive disproportionately strong placement in specialist rooms and long-tail paths rather than being hidden behind rank.
matching_and_traversal_rules.cold_start_rule: Use explicit path choice plus broad observed language/device-time signals; do not infer sensitive traits.

principles: Mature content is a visible district boundary.
Gambling zones have age gates, spending-limit symbolism and probability education objects.
Prank/social-experiment zones display consent and context markers.
Drama and debate zones display source/context plaques and moderation presence.
Harassment, doxxing and non-consensual targeting are never converted into a celebratory world theme.

world_node.description: A place-like taxonomy entity: region, realm, district, island, room, biome, harbour, venue or weather layer.

streamer.description: A ranked creator with observed metrics and multi-axis editorial memberships.

circle.description: A visible community island defined by topic/game + style/vibe + lifespan.

room.description: An intimate enterable interior at the bottom of the discovery funnel.

landmark.description: A walk-up object that embodies a product surface or route decision.

tribe_role.description: A visible community job with cosmetics and ambient behaviour.

season_node.description: A physical progression node on an island trail.

deepens_to.meaning: Moves farther down the belonging funnel.

portal_to.meaning: Secondary taste axis accessible through an embodied portal.

magnitude_link.meaning: Connects to BIG, MEDIUM or SMALL/NICHE rank geography.

manifests_as.meaning: Converts an abstract product surface into world form.

pulses_as.meaning: Live activity is expressed as weather.

grows_as.meaning: Member devotion and contribution are expressed as growth.

cardinality_rules: A streamer has exactly one primary home_at world node at a time.
A streamer may have zero to many portal_to secondary nodes.
A Circle requires exactly one topic/game identity, one style/vibe identity and one lifespan.
A Circle contains one or more rooms and exactly one shared Great Tree.
Every populated world node exposes up to 20 ranked example streamers plus its full membership list.
Every inferred creator label stores confidence; low-confidence labels are provisional.
normalisation_rules: Use canonical node IDs in relationships; use labels only for display.
Never overwrite observed platform categories with editorial taxonomy labels.
Keep rankings numeric and store formatted display values separately.
A multi-category creator is represented by many memberships, not duplicated creator records.
Temporary trends create pop-up Circles rather than mutating permanent identity without evidence.

region.top_streamers.fantasy: A living world fair rather than a leaderboard page.
region.top_streamers.weather: Pulse beacons above each pavilion; rank movement appears as migrating banners, not flashing tables.
npc_behaviours: Scouts leave the boulevard for niche trails
missions: Visit one BIG and one SMALL/NICHE pavilion sharing a vibe
Take a language ferry from a creator pavilion
Find a creator through a secondary door rather than rank order

region.game_realms.fantasy: A continent where mechanics and player motivations are readable as terrain.
region.game_realms.weather: Competitive regions storm during tournaments; sandbox regions grow visible constructions; roleplay cities light faction districts.
missions: Watch one newcomer guide
Join a cross-game mechanic trail
Contribute a clip to a title trophy wall

region.vibe_archipelago.fantasy: Choose how you want to feel before choosing what to watch.
region.vibe_archipelago.weather: Mood is the climate: dusk, sunshine, storm energy, fireplace fog or focus rain.
missions: Spend time in two islands with opposite intensity
Welcome a newcomer without requiring chat spam
Grow a shared mood garden

region.doing_districts.fantasy: Belong through shared activity, not only shared fandom.
region.doing_districts.weather: Visible productivity: smoke, stage lights, deploy bells, cooking steam, gym crowds and event scaffolds.
missions: Help label a resource
Join a collaborative task
Attend a live demonstration
Leave a useful artefact for the next visitor

region.reacts_troll.fantasy: A spectacle district where context, consent and tone are visible before entry.
region.reacts_troll.weather: Laughing winds for playful content, red evidence lanterns for drama, newsroom pips for current events and storm warnings for escalation.
npc_behaviours: audiences vote on tone without targeting individuals
missions: Add context to a clip
Separate fact from opinion
Choose a good-natured route over a harassment route
cool down an On Fire island through constructive participation
region.reacts_troll.hard_boundary: Harassment, doxxing, coercion and non-consensual targeting are excluded from celebratory taxonomy and routed to safety systems.

region.language_harbours.fantasy: Cultural ports linked by ferries that preserve context while enabling discovery across languages.
region.language_harbours.weather: Local festival banners and language-specific Pulse calls.
missions: Cross a language bridge through a shared game or vibe
help translate a Circle sign
visit a culturally local event

pathfinding_costs.diversity_bonus: Subtract 0.15 when a route changes language or audience magnitude while preserving game, vibe or activity.
pathfinding_costs.repetition_penalty: Add 0.25 for repeating the same creator cohort, language and magnitude on consecutive recommendations.

traversal_graph.recommended_path_algorithm: Weighted shortest path with diversity bonus and a hard requirement that the final step is a physical room, Circle or creator pavilion.

minimum_demo_slice: One connected overworld with Shallows, Ridgeline and Peaks.
Top Streamers Region with at least 12 creator pavilions spanning all three magnitude bands.
At least four Circle islands: IRL Chaos, Late Night Watchers, Clip Hunters and one GTA RP pop-up.
At least one Game Realm route, one Vibe route and one Doing route that converge on the same creator.
At least one island visibly transitions Pulse state during the demo.
At least one member garden and the shared Great Tree visibly update.
12–20 distinct NPCs with wandering, gathering and role behaviours.

data_refresh.rank_metrics: Refresh on the analytics provider cadence.
data_refresh.platform_categories: Refresh from recent channel/VOD/category history daily or before a major demo.
data_refresh.editorial_labels: Re-score weekly, but require human review for low-confidence or safety-sensitive labels.
data_refresh.circle_lifespan: Derive from recurrence and event schedule; automatically expire pop-ups unless renewed.

privacy_and_fairness: Do not infer protected or sensitive traits.
Do not equate audience size with community quality.
Expose why a route exists using visible sign language and inspectable evidence.
Give users a direct way to move, hide, mute and reset routes.
Allow creators and communities to contest or edit editorial vibe labels.
